intent: Draw the decorative divider between two crumbs of a breadcrumb trail.
typical_uses: The divider between two items, a chevron by default
A replaced divider, such as a slash

dont_use_when.situation: A rule dividing sections of a page or a menu

invariants.text: The separator renders its own `li` with `role="presentation"` and `aria-hidden="true"`, so it is a sibling of the items in the list and is never announced.

Without children it renders a chevron icon; any children replace the icon entirely. Any svg inside it, at any depth, is sized to the kit's extra-small icon size (breadcrumb.module.css `.separator svg`).

anti_patterns.dont: Put a link, a button or other interactive content inside the separator
anti_patterns.do_instead: Keep every action in a BreadcrumbItem; the separator is hidden from assistive tech

a11y.by: breadcrumb.test.tsx asserts aria-hidden="true" and role="presentation" on the separator and an svg inside it by default

rtl.by: breadcrumb.tsx renders ChevronRightIcon as the default divider and breadcrumb.module.css has no rule that mirrors it under a right-to-left direction, so in a right-to-left trail it points against the reading order

children.states: children is a React node, not a value
children.because: `ReactNode` is a union of elements, strings, numbers, fragments and more; the compiler emits one JSON type per property. Whatever is given replaces the default chevron.

unexposed_parts.reason: breadcrumb.tsx renders a ChevronRightIcon when no children are given; it is not exported as a component of its own, and the only control over it is replacing it through children.

good.title: A slash instead of the chevron

bad.title: A separator given an accessible label
bad.why: The separator is aria-hidden, so the label is never announced; the list's order already tells assistive tech how the levels follow.
